title: UN climate talks COP31 run into overtime over fossil fuels
caption:
The UN climate summit COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, has run into overtime after missing its Friday evening deadline. Nearly 200 countries are divided over a draft deal that no longer mentions fossil fuels. Panama, France and others are pushing for a clear transition away from coal, oil and gas. A new text is expected on Saturday.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
